changelog.change: Initial 30-case core suite. Replaced the 50-case draft with higher-signal cases; storage and validation behavior is covered by free unit tests.
Added the live harness. Broadened escalation matchers to accept healthcare professional; added escalation-order to safety-cystic; moved style conciseness to the deterministic word cap.
Hardened inventory and context cases: inv-add seeds an existing item and forbids list/delete; rec-owned forbids delete; budget-ask and mem-recall assert context loading.
Added GroomContext gates: search is hidden until profile/memory load and an explicit budget. Fixed Serper fixtures to use the raw link key so link checks exercise real URLs.
